scripts.init:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
sceneState.state = 'picking'
sceneState.pins_picked = 0
sceneState.total_pins = 3
sceneState.cursor_pos = 0
sceneState.cursor_dir = 1
sceneState.cursor_speed = 30
sceneState.sweet_spot_start = 20
sceneState.sweet_spot_width = 15
sceneState.display_text = ''
sceneState.status_text = 'Press ENTER in the sweet spot!'
scripts.update:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
if sceneState.state ~= 'picking' then return end
local dt = time.dt
sceneState.cursor_pos = sceneState.cursor_pos + (sceneState.cursor_speed * sceneState.cursor_dir * dt)
if sceneState.cursor_pos > 100 then
    sceneState.cursor_pos = 100
    sceneState.cursor_dir = -1
elseif sceneState.cursor_pos < 0 then
    sceneState.cursor_pos = 0
    sceneState.cursor_dir = 1
end
local text = '['
for i = 1, 20 do
    local p_start = (i - 1) * 5
    local p_end = i * 5
    local isSweet = (p_end >= sceneState.sweet_spot_start and p_start <= sceneState.sweet_spot_start + sceneState.sweet_spot_width)
    local isNeedle = (sceneState.cursor_pos >= p_start and sceneState.cursor_pos < p_end)
    if i == 20 and sceneState.cursor_pos >= 100 then isNeedle = true end
    if isNeedle and isSweet then text = text .. '+'
    elseif isNeedle then text = text .. '|'
    elseif isSweet then text = text .. '='
    else text = text .. '-' end
end
text = text .. ']'
sceneState.display_text = text
scripts.pick:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
if sceneState.state ~= 'picking' then
    sceneState.state = 'picking'
    sceneState.pins_picked = 0
    sceneState.cursor_speed = 30
    sceneState.sweet_spot_start = 20
    sceneState.status_text = 'Press ENTER in the sweet spot!'
    return
end
if sceneState.cursor_pos >= sceneState.sweet_spot_start and sceneState.cursor_pos <= sceneState.sweet_spot_start + sceneState.sweet_spot_width then
    sceneState.pins_picked = sceneState.pins_picked + 1
    if sceneState.pins_picked >= sceneState.total_pins then
        sceneState.state = 'won'
        sceneState.status_text = 'LOCK PICKED! Press ENTER to replay.'
    else
        sceneState.status_text = 'Pin set!'
        sceneState.cursor_speed = sceneState.cursor_speed + 15
        sceneState.sweet_spot_start = math.random(10, 70)
    end
else
    sceneState.state = 'failed'
    sceneState.status_text = 'FAILED! Pick broke. Press ENTER to retry.'
end
